details.label: Discussion
details.text: Isolated thunderstorms are developing near the IN/OH state border this afternoon. This activity is developing ahead of a stalled front and on the southern periphery of stronger effective shear located north of this boundary. Stronger heating across east-central IN into central OH has allowed temperatures to warm into the 80s to near 90 F amid mid 70s F dewpoints, resulting in moderate instability. Effective shear magnitudes around 20-30 kt may allow for some storm organization. However, weak midlevel lapse rates will limit longevity of any stronger/better organized updrafts. Nevertheless, steepened low-level lapse rates and high PW values could support sporadic strong outflow wind gusts. Overall, the risk is expected to remain limited and mostly sub-severe wind gusts are anticipated, precluding watch issuance
